text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I knew it. I've put on a little weight…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll have to control what I eat while still retaining as much muscle as possible.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, what do we have here? If it isn't Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My my! Isn't it a coincidence bumping into each other here of all places?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You seem to be having some trouble managing your weight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Haa ha ha! That reaction tells me I hit the nail on the head!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come now… It was a simple inference to make. One look at your dejected expression after stepping onto the scale tells it all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sure… but it's got nothing to do with you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You are quite right! But you should be grateful to me all the same, as I came here to bring you some exceptionally good news!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're probably just looking for test subjects for whatever new concoction you came up with.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ohh, you're not half bad at conjecture yourself. That's absolutely correct! You see, I've developed a formula that allows you to freely manipulate your own weight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, how about it? I get my hands on a little data for my research, and you get your ideal body weight! It's a win-win situation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's a shame. But if you change your mind, don't hesitate to come and see me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I need to sort out my weight myself to avoid getting tempted into any weird experiments.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Admire Vega's encounter, she takes her diet seriously and succeeds in managing her weight.
